responsibility: Specifies ISO raw channel I/O for uninterpreted storage units. It declares read and write procedures over an explicit IOChan channel and arrays of SYSTEM.LOC, forming the lowest-level byte/word transfer interface in the standard I/O stack, with read completion reported through the shared IOConsts.ReadResults mechanism maintained by IOChan.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the ISO-specified interface for raw channel transfer, declaring only Read and Write on arrays of SYSTEM.LOC. Its paired RawIO.mod file supplies the runtime wrapper logic that drives IOChan.RawRead/RawWrite, handles looping on partial reads, and flushes output streams before reading.
